Let \(a_0=0\). For each \(n=1,\dots,85\), since \(a_{19}=85\), we have \(b_n\le 19\). Also \(b_n=m\) exactly when
\[
a_{m-1}<n\le a_m.
\]
Thus the number of \(n\) with \(b_n=m\) is \(a_m-a_{m-1}\), so
\[
\sum_{n=1}^{85} b_n=\sum_{m=1}^{19} m(a_m-a_{m-1})
=19a_{19}-\sum_{m=1}^{18}a_m.
\]
Therefore the total sum is
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{19}a_i+\sum_{n=1}^{85}b_n
=
\sum_{i=1}^{19}a_i+19\cdot 85-\sum_{i=1}^{18}a_i
= a_{19}+19\cdot 85
=85+1615=1700.
\]
So the maximum possible value is constant.

\[
\boxed{1700}
\]
